name: AMS
description: AMS temperature, humidity, reported drying status and four filament trays, with active-tray highlighting. Select a telemetry array entry with ?ams=N; the default is 1. Use ?ams=0 for a single AMS.

ams.description: Index in print.ams.ams, starting at 0. Default 1; use 0 for a single AMS. Check telemetry when matching physical units.

bindings.label: AMS unit object
bindings.hint: Telemetry paths use array positions, e.g. $.print.ams.ams[0] for the first reported unit. Available units depend on the printer and firmware.
